summary: Full backend + frontend testing for iteration 4 (Ordem de Serviço, Stripe/PIX payments, Copilot ops). All 14 backend pytest cases PASS (OS CRUD, OS from-lead, OS to-project idempotent, checkout guest for starter subscription + founder-deal PIX one-time with graceful fallback, os-checkout auth-guarded, payments/status public, founder-deal counter, copilot create-task/generate-proposal/generate-report incl. persistence to /api/documents, auth guards). Frontend flows also mostly pass: Founder counter renders from /api/public/founder-deal (100 vagas restantes, not hardcoded 57), founder-cta redirects to checkout.stripe.com, Free plan CTA navigates to /login, /app/os page renders with nav item 'Ordem de Serviço', manual OS creation + total calc works, quick-fromlead creates OS, to-project button works, pay-os-<id> redirects to Stripe, Copilot quick actions (task/proposal/report) open dialogs, submit, and render results (proposal + report markdown + copy button visible). PaymentSuccess with invalid session_id shows friendly 'Ops!' error (no crash) and PaymentCancel renders correctly. FOUND ONE HIGH PRIORITY UI BUG: plan-cta-<starter|growth|business> buttons wire onClick to primaryCta (navigate to /login) instead of clickPlanCta(p) — see Landing.jsx line 890.

ui_bugs.issue: All paid plan CTA buttons (Starter/Growth/Business) navigate to /login instead of starting Stripe Checkout. The onClick handler is hardcoded to `primaryCta` at line 890 instead of `() => clickPlanCta(p)`. The `clickPlanCta` function is defined but never called. Only 'Free' plan should route to /login; paid plans should call startCheckout with lookup_monthly/yearly + trial_days:30. Founder deal button works correctly because it uses `clickFounderCta`.

issues: Radix warns: DialogContent missing DialogTitle/Description (accessibility). Wrap titles in VisuallyHidden or add explicit DialogTitle/Description for cop-quick-task, proposal, report dialogs.

action_items: Fix Landing.jsx line ~890: change `onClick={primaryCta}` to `onClick={() => clickPlanCta(p)}` so paid plan CTAs start Stripe checkout with trial_days=30. This blocks the entire pricing→checkout funnel for Starter/Growth/Business.
(Minor) Add DialogTitle/Description to Copilot task/proposal/report dialogs for a11y compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx clickPlanCta is dead code because the button's onClick uses primaryCta directly. This is a wiring bug — high impact.
server.py is now 1517 lines; consider splitting into modules (crm.py, os.py, payments.py, copilot.py) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
Copilot dialogs missing DialogTitle/Description — will fail WCAG audits (screen reader users).

Payment /api/payments/status endpoint is public — anyone with a session_id can poll. Amount + lookup_key are leaked. Consider requiring the transaction to belong to the caller when authenticated, or restrict fields for anonymous callers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints (OS, payments, copilot ops, founder-deal) fully functional and covered by pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_4_os_payments_copilot.py (14 tests, all pass in ~45s). Only remaining bug is a one-line frontend wiring issue on the pricing section — after fix, retest plan-cta-{starter,growth,business} for Stripe redirect. Copilot quick actions confirmed to work end-to-end including AI generation (~20-25s wait). PIX on Stripe sandbox: for founder-deal, pix_enabled came back true in this environment.
rca of the issue: Landing.jsx renders each pricing plan card and defines a `clickPlanCta(p)` helper at line 527 that correctly branches (free → /login; paid → startCheckout(lookup, trial_days:30)). However, the button element on line 889-901 wires `onClick={primaryCta}` directly. `primaryCta` unconditionally navigates to /login (or /app if authenticated). Consequences: (a) Free plan works by coincidence; (b) all paid plan CTAs bypass Stripe entirely. Repro: open landing (guest), click any paid plan-cta → observe navigation to /login and NO network call to /api/payments/checkout (verified by request interception in Playwright). Fix: replace `onClick={primaryCta}` with `onClick={() => clickPlanCta(p)}` on line 890 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx.
